snippet.title: Valheim: 1.0 & Deep North reveal trailer - PC Gaming Show 2026
snippet.description:
Sharpen your axes and prepare to conquer the Deep North – Valheim exits Early Access and releases into 1.0 on 9 September 2026! 

Download the early access game now on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/892970/Valheim?snr=1_1056_615_pcgamingshow2026_100703&curator_clanid=1850

Valheim is available for purchase on the Steam, Microsoft/Xbox, Humble and Mac App stores. Upon release, Valheim will also be available on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2.

https://www.pcgamer.com

X: https://x.com/pcgamer
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@pcgamer_mag
